explanation: PFS figures and 'no statistically significant OS benefit' are accurate per evidence. However, text omits that both trials showed numerical OS improvement (PALOMA-2: 53.9 vs 51.2 mo; PALOMA-3: 34.9 vs 28.0 mo, p=0.043) and were not powered for OS, which could mislead learners into thinking OS showed no trend at all.
suggested_rewrite: Note that both trials showed a numerical trend toward longer OS with palbociclib (PALOMA-2: 53.9 vs 51.2 months; PALOMA-3: 34.9 vs 28.0 months), but neither reached statistical significance, partly because they were not powered to detect an OS difference.
